fact: In November 2022 the ARCEP Benin executive secretary said Benin has a national backbone with security loops in the south-east and north, nearly 2,000 km of fibre, with about 67 of 77 communes directly connected.
title: Hervé Guedegbe de l'Arcep Benin : « Environ 67 communes sur 77 ont un accès direct à la fibre optique »
